done_when: A repeatable MTS doctor run exists: one command or card template that reads the AI-help files (CLAUDE.md, memory index, system docs, task cards, handoff notes) and the project health signals (CI, STATUS.md, stale claims, open halts, token audit), and writes one dated report with a short list of findings, each with an owner and a next step. Running it twice on the same day gives the same report.
goal: Create the MTS doctor: a recurring check that reviews the AI help material and the overall health of the project, so the same check can be run again without rebuilding it. It reports only; it never edits rules, clears halts, or deploys.
